cases.purpose: With no signal option pkill sends SIGTERM to every selected owned process, leaves unselected siblings alive, and never signals the invoking shell.
cases.oracle: procps-ng 4.0.4 pkill run by the reference bash side against the same fixture processes
cases.comparison: Byte parity of stdout, stderr (location prefix normalized) and status; children are owned fixture processes (symlinks of sleep with unique names) and their end states are read back with kill -0 / wait status.
